verdict_reason: The consignment contact tests are removed correctly, but a bad rebase also deletes every germinal products registry test, one of which openspec coverage still links.

todos.issue: The PR deletes the whole 'germinal products journey' describe block, not only its consignment contact test: 'resolves the %s handshake to the same party as the live animals handshake', 'builds the %s handshake's return address under the germinal products set base' and 'gives the %s handshake the same own role, other roles and saved roles as the live animals handshake' all go. The germinal products entry is still registered (journey-registry.js:43), nothing else in src tests it now, and openspec/coverage/ins/address-book/coverage.json:6133 still links the 'builds the %s handshake's return address…' title. It also drops the roleOfParty import those tests used. The rebase of 70533d89 over main's 75aac721 took the pre-germinal file.
todos.fix: Must: the germinal products registry entry is tested as it is on main, only the 'resolves the consignment contact handshake to the contact' test is gone, and every coverage.json link to journey-registry.test.js names a test that exists. One way: restore the describe block (and the roleOfParty import) from origin/main and delete only the contact test.
